query:
WITH ins AS (
            INSERT INTO subjects (kind, did, uri, created_at)
            VALUES ($1, $2, NULL, now())
            ON CONFLICT (did) WHERE kind = 'account' AND did IS NOT NULL
            DO NOTHING
            RETURNING id
        )
        SELECT id FROM ins
        UNION ALL
        SELECT id FROM subjects WHERE kind = $1 AND did = $2
        LIMIT 1
